document_evidence.scope: Reference-analysis settings; no verified mapping from qX_p2n labels to MDU.

document_evidence.facts: The 71 supplied qX_p2n100 through qX_p2n800 configurations in steps of 10 were confirmed as the complete set for the initial analysis. Additional in-between configurations could be supplied if necessary.

document_evidence.scope: Measurement-program and eigensolver documentation. Generic example first/last/step values are not qX generation metadata.

ordering_assumption: Increasing integer configuration labels are used provisionally as one ordered series. This assumption is not established by the supplied generation documentation.
bin_policy: Split block construction at missing nominal labels; anchor full equal-size bins at the start of each contiguous label run. Discard incomplete end bins, record every excluded label, and compare blocked and unblocked errors on exactly the same selected configurations. The runs are not declared independent replicas.
main_cohort: 70 configurations excluding n640; original full-ensemble estimates remain unchanged. Bins of width 1 and 2 retain all 70 configurations. Larger-bin subsets are diagnostics.
interpretation: Conditional error-binning sensitivity, not a final autocorrelation correction, integrated autocorrelation-time estimate or proof of independence. The r0/r1 tail parameter is not transferred to flux-tube observables.
